# What you have after installing sevenx_multisite

This page is for administrators, hosts and website creators who have just installed `sevenx_multisite` (or its clean
variant) and want to check the result or know where to start. It answers: what the installation consists of, which
files hold its settings, and what is deliberately switched off.

![The content tree after installing: one folder per site](../../images/help/sp-sevenx-tree.webp)

## Contents

1. [The two websites](#the-two-websites)
2. [Siteaccesses and settings files](#siteaccesses-and-settings-files)
3. [Content, classes and layouts](#content-classes-and-layouts)
4. [Users and roles](#users-and-roles)
5. [Caches, feeds and statistics](#caches-feeds-and-statistics)
6. [What is switched off](#what-is-switched-off)
7. [A checklist](#a-checklist)

## The two websites

| Site | Home node remote id | Siteaccesses | Default name |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fit & Healthy | `media-n-939` | `site` and one per extra language | the title typed in the setup, else "Fit & Healthy" |
| Bold Agency | `media-n-940` | `bold` (English), `bold_ger` (German) | "Bold Agency" |

Both use the `media` design of `sevenx_themes_media`. The Bold siteaccesses are reached by path on the main address
(`/bold/`, `/bold_ger/`). Links between the two sites are written for the siteaccess that serves the target, through
`ezurlmultisite` (see [Multisite cross-site links](../../../features/6.0/multisite-cross-site-links.md)).

## Siteaccesses and settings files

| Path | Written by |
|---|---|
| `settings/override/site.ini.append.php` | `commonSiteINISettings()`: siteaccess lists and matching, `ActiveExtensions`, database, session, HTTP headers, static cache switch |
| `settings/override/content.ini`, `menu.ini`, `viewcache.ini`, `staticcache.ini`, `httpcache.ini`, `override.ini`, `forum.ini`, `ezoe_attributes.ini`, `ezxml.ini` (`.append.php`) | `commonINISettings()` |
| `settings/override/sevenxauthentication2fa.ini.append.php` | when `sevenx_authentication_2fa` is installed |
| `settings/override/ezurlmultisite.ini.append.php` | step 48: `[MultisiteSettings] SiteAccessList[]` and `RootNodeList[]` with this installation's node ids |
| `settings/siteaccess/site/` | the setup and the installer, eleven groups of `siteINISettings()` |
| `settings/siteaccess/bold/`, `bold_ger/` | `site.ini.append.php` and `menu.ini.append.php` by the installer, the rest from the theme extension |
| `settings/siteaccess/admin/` | the setup and the installer, ten groups of `adminINISettings()` |
| `settings/siteaccess/editor/`, `adminui/` | copies of the admin siteaccess, made after the post-install |

Details per siteaccess: [Siteaccesses and languages](siteaccesses-and-languages.md).

## Content, classes and layouts

- The 33 classes of `sevenx_classes` (six of them kept from the base data) and the 31 `ng_*` classes in the class
  groups "Netgen" and "Netgen Components"; the `cjw_newsletter` classes in a group "Newsletter" with a newsletter tree.
- With `sevenx_multisite`: 291 content objects of the demo content. With `sevenx_multisite_clean`: 35 objects, the
  structure, forms and legal pages.
- 21 published layouts with zones, blocks, collections and rules, two of them shared ("Header / Footer",
  "Prefooter"), and the three default admin layouts.
- 31 tags and the tag links of the demo content.
- An image for the site logo (`logo.png` from the package) and the site style `ezwebin_design_blue` on the
  `template_look` object, plus twelve new "look and feel" fields such as the footer text
  ("Copyright © <year> 7x (except where otherwise noted). All rights reserved.").

See [The demo content packages](the-demo-content-packages.md) and
[Layouts data and the share .dba files](layouts-data-and-share-dba.md).

## Users and roles

- A section "Restricted" and a user group "Partners" in it; "Guest accounts" renamed to "Members".
- Policies for Anonymous, Member, Editor and Partner; see [Roles and policies](roles-and-policies.md).
- The administrator's admin preferences: content structure, roles, policies, tree menu and bookmarks shown.

## Caches, feeds and statistics

| Feature | State after the install | Where |
|---|---|---|
| Static cache | **off** (`[ContentSettings] StaticCache=disabled`), but fully configured: `CachedSiteAccesses` = every public siteaccess, `MaxCacheDepth=12`, `StaticStorageDir=static` | `settings/override/site.ini`, `staticcache.ini` |
| HTTP cache | which siteaccesses: every public one; whether it is on stays the kernel default | `settings/override/httpcache.ini` |
| Browser and proxy caching | `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300` and `Expires` 300 for anonymous visitors on content pages | `[HTTPHeaderSettings]` in `settings/override/site.ini` |
| View cache | `SmartCacheClear=enabled` with dependency rules per class | `viewcache.ini` |
| Search statistics | `[SearchSettings] LogSearchStats=enabled` on every siteaccess the installer wrote | each `site.ini.append.php` |
| RSS feed | "My RSS Feed" at `/rss/feed/my_feed`, the `ng_article` objects below the Fit & Healthy home, 10 items, RSS 2.0; not made by `_clean` packages | the RSS export list of the admin |

The static cache is installed off because "every publish refreshes the cached pages of every address the object
appears at", which made a single publish take seconds. The comment in `commonSiteINISettings()` says how to switch it
on: generate the cache first, then set the one setting.

## What is switched off

| Item | Setting |
|---|---|
| The `ezinfo` module on public siteaccesses | `[SiteAccessRules] Rules` `access;enable`, `moduleall`, `access;disable`, `module;ezinfo` on every siteaccess whose design is not an admin design |
| Debug output | `[DebugSettings] DebugOutput=disabled`, `[TemplateSettings] Debug=disabled` |
| Delayed indexing | `[SearchSettings] DelayedIndexing=disabled` |
| Two-step sign-in enforcement | `Enforce2FA=disabled` (users choose) |
| `expai` | installed with `[AISettings] Enabled=false` by the extension itself, no provider key |

## A checklist

- [ ] `settings/override/site.ini.append.php` lists `site`, `bold`, `bold_ger`, `admin`, `editor` (and `adminui`) in
      `AvailableSiteAccessList`.
- [ ] The front page shows Fit & Healthy, and `/bold/` shows Bold Agency.
- [ ] `settings/siteaccess/site/site.ini.append.php` has a non-empty `PathPrefix` and an `IndexPage` other than
      `/content/view/full/2`.
- [ ] `settings/override/ezurlmultisite.ini.append.php` exists and names node ids.
- [ ] The admin opens in the `admin4l` design, and the Editor siteaccess in `editor`.
- [ ] The setup reported no `EZSW-080`, `EZSW-081` or `EZSW-082`.

> **Tip**
> If a page below a site root answers 404, check `PathPrefix` and the URL aliases first: those are the parts the
> post-install builds last. See [Post-install fixes](post-install-fixes.md#url-aliases-and-site-prefixes).
